text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we work. Many companies now use automation to handle repetitive tasks, which saves time and reduces mistakes. Productivity tools powered by AI, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help employees work faster and focus on more important things. Instead of replacing people, AI often works alongside them. This human-AI collaboration allows workers to make better decisions and solve problems more quickly. However, jobs are changing. Some tasks are disappearing, while new skills are needed. For this reason, learning how to use AI tools is becoming essential for many workers who want to stay competitive in a modern workplace.
